abstract: Library-free scroll polish: CSS smooth scrolling plus an IntersectionObserver reveal (fade-up, fade, slide, scale, staggered) with a .js gate, reduced-motion, no-IO and print handling, a native animation-timeline view() variant, an Elementor fadeInUp mapping, a runnable template, and a DevTools probe for measuring a real page's reveal timings. Original timing values were not measured and are labeled as such.
